title: Animated-Website Dossier Router
description: Deterministic input->output routing so an agent does not have to re-derive kind/stack decisions by reading prose tables across 13+ files. Consumes a brief, emits an ordered build plan. Authority: 01_kinds.md, 01_kinds_taxonomy.md, 02_resources.md, 05_conversion_playbook.md.

audience.effect: gates which stack tier is offered; non_technical_founder routes to no-code, never to a raw engine pick

perf_tier.effect: strict caps JS budget at 100KB gz and forbids kind ii/iii/ix full-viewport scenes unless has_3d_asset is explicitly true

brand_intensity.effect: selects the typography/duration profile in 06_motion_grammar.md (family-editorial-* vs family-product-* vs family-playful-*)

section_count.effect: < 3 sections disqualifies kind (i) per 01_kind-i_scroll_reveal.md why-not checklist

output.reason: per 01_kinds.md §5 + 06_no_code_platforms.md §8: founders are not picking an engine

routing_rules.reason: microinteraction is mandatory baseline per 01_kinds.md §7 / 04_do_dont.md; every button/link needs hover+focus feedback

routing_rules.engine_pick: CSS animation-timeline if browser_support_acceptable else GSAP ScrollTrigger + Lenis
routing_rules.reason: 01_kind-i_scroll_reveal.md why-not checklist: <3 sections disqualifies this kind

routing_rules.constraint: consumes the ONE motion.limit.full-viewport-scenes slot; no kind-iii/ix full-viewport scene may coexist
routing_rules.reason: 02_kind-ii_3d_scene.md: use when product is physical and glTF asset exists

routing_rules.condition: site_type in ['marketing_landing','saas_app_marketing'] AND has_3d_asset == false AND perf_tier != 'strict'
choices: kind-ix (generative art, p5.js/canvas-sketch, lower authoring cost)
routing_rules.reason: 01_kinds.md §5 'Fill a hero with a fluid/gradient/particle background'

routing_rules.sub_pick: dotLottie for stateless loops; Rive if onboarding/empty-state needs hover->active->pressed states

routing_rules.constraint: only if real asset load > 1s; NEVER add as decoration (06_kind-vi_preloader.md 'Avoid mandatory preloaders')
routing_rules.reason: heavy hero assets (glTF, video) justify a load mask

routing_rules.engine_pick: View Transitions API with Swup/Barba.js fallback for Firefox
routing_rules.reason: 07_kind-vii_page_transitions.md; only relevant to SPA route changes, not MPA

routing_rules.condition: audience == 'senior_dev' AND site_type in ['portfolio','marketing_landing'] AND perf_tier != 'strict'
routing_rules.constraint: must be disabled on (pointer: coarse); do not add to product_ecommerce forms
AudioContext must be gated behind explicit user gesture; no autoplay

manual opt-in only (mirrors R12 for kind-xii) — requires a real glTF+USDZ pair (K11-1) and physical-product context; router never auto-selects even for product_ecommerce + has_3d_asset. USDZ has no open-source writer, so the kind is intentionally without a starter scaffold until a real user request arrives.
routing_rules.reason: 11_kind-xi_ar_model_viewer.md — iOS-only AR Quick Look needs USDZ; until user explicitly asks, omit the kind

routing_rules.constraint: single-flight lock mandatory; never auto-invoked by this router without explicit opt-in

budget_allocation_after_routing.rule: sum ADD_KIND full-viewport-scene consumers across the plan; if > 1, router MUST fail with a conflict error rather than silently picking one

motion.limit.concurrent.note: sum of simultaneously-visible animated tracks across ALL active kinds on one viewport, not per-kind

output_schema.ordered_kind_list: array of kind IDs in build order (baseline kind-viii first, hero surface kind last so it can respect the full-viewport-scene budget check)
output_schema.token_profile: one of editorial | product | playful, selects typography.family-* and duration bias per 06_motion_grammar.md
output_schema.starter_scaffold_ref: path into starters/ matching framework + primary_engine
output_schema.file_refs: array of dossier file paths the agent must read before generating code for each selected kind
output_schema.conflicts: array, non-empty only if budget_allocation check failed — router must surface this to the human before proceeding
